note: CLOSED vocabulary. A corpus case may carry exactly one label: a defect class from this list, or the clean control. Nothing here describes a real observed defect - every class is derived from a requirement or a signed case that already exists IN THIS REPOSITORY, and each carries the citation to it. `sourceCitation.file` is validated to exist on disk, so a class can never cite a document that was renamed or never written. Populating a class with anonymized REAL defect history is the deferred work recorded in docs/adr/0052-synthetic-corpus-and-provenance-split.md; until then no class here is evidence that the defect has ever occurred in production.

cleanControlLabel.title: Labeled clean control
cleanControlLabel.description: A case that carries NO defect. Controls exist so a false-positive rate can be reported beside defect coverage: a detector that blocks everything scores perfect coverage and must be caught by its false-positive rate instead.

defectClasses.title: Household or party identity resolved from an ambiguous name
defectClasses.description: Two households share a surname, or a trust name contains a household surname, and the system binds a request to one of them without a human selection.

defectClasses.title: Authority inferred from household membership or an expired grant
defectClasses.description: A signer's authority is derived from household membership, or an authority that lapsed inside the evidence-gathering interval is treated as still in force.

defectClasses.title: Payment destination accepted on an insufficient discriminator
defectClasses.description: A destination is treated as identified by bank plus last-four, or a destination change's blast radius is scoped to one account when the instruction is shared.

defectClasses.title: Conflicting instructions collapsed instead of surfaced
defectClasses.description: Two owners of one account, or two instruction planes, disagree and the system silently picks one instead of routing the conflict to a human.

defectClasses.title: Reserve floor computed from a scalar monthly withdrawal
defectClasses.description: The reserve floor assumes one flat monthly amount, or assumes a schedule exists at all, so a segmented or absent schedule produces a wrong or fabricated floor.

defectClasses.title: Stale evidence carried into a material computation
defectClasses.description: An input beyond its freshness window feeds a decision because freshness was recorded by the producer rather than recomputed against the firm's window.

defectClasses.title: Evidence treated as a point rather than an interval
defectClasses.description: A fact that changed between observation and retrieval is reported as of one instant, hiding the change.

defectClasses.title: Restriction lifecycle ignored
defectClasses.description: A recorded restriction is treated as in force regardless of its effective window, so an expired one blocks and a future-dated one does not.

defectClasses.title: Legal-hold scope widened or narrowed
defectClasses.description: A position-level hold is applied to the whole account, or ignored because the account itself is unheld.

defectClasses.title: Pending activity reduced effective liquidity uniformly
defectClasses.description: All pending activity is netted the same way, so a blocked action is counted as if it will settle.

defectClasses.title: Local time rendered from a fixed offset
defectClasses.description: An instant is rendered with a hardcoded UTC offset, or a business-day count lands on a weekend, because the time-zone database was not consulted.

defectClasses.title: Identity compared on non-canonical bytes
defectClasses.description: Two spellings of one name (composed and decomposed Unicode) are treated as different subjects, or one canonical form is assumed without normalizing.

defectClasses.title: Threshold applied at the boundary instead of above it
defectClasses.description: A rule written as 'above X' fires at exactly X, or vice versa, so requests at the exact threshold route to the wrong authority.

defectClasses.title: Deadline feasibility assumed
defectClasses.description: A requested deadline earlier than the decision instant, or unreachable in business days, is accepted as satisfiable.

defectClasses.title: Change blast radius scoped too narrowly
defectClasses.description: A single shared record is changed and only its primary subject is re-evaluated, leaving the other affected subjects on stale conclusions.

defectClasses.title: Liquidity treated as source-agnostic
defectClasses.description: A funding source is selected on balance alone, so the only sufficient source being a retirement account produces a recommendation with an unstated tax consequence.
